scope: Exact-name LepTraits matches only; no GBIF synonym normalization yet. This is therefore a conservative matched-trait feasibility result, not the final normalized census.

major_complete_geographic_support.split_rule: SHA256('lepidoptera-trait-transfer-v0.1|major_complete|<species>'), lower half train, upper half evaluation

decision.interpretation: The within-Lepidoptera trait-gradient study is feasible even before synonym normalization or moth-trait augmentation. Trait completeness does not collapse the panel, and geographic source support is not concentrated at the five-source minimum.

identity_firewall_note.operator_exposure_exception: During archive-layout inspection, raw sequence text for Acrolophus arcanella was inadvertently rendered. That species is outside the exact LepTraits-matched eligible set used for every result in this receipt and must remain excluded from any future trait-transfer panel.
